translated: ...What is it?
...You say it first.
...Fine, I'll say it first.
I will defeat Odin.
...Aren't you surprised?
I was thinking of saying the same thing.
...I see.

I will go to the top of Yggdrasil.
There I will gain all wisdom and become a god.

You know it, right? It's the tree that is
the source of creation for the world, including Asgard.
...That is possible!?

Silmeria acknowledged it too!
I won't let it end as an armchair theory!

Long ago, Odin too was but a lower god
with the body of a half-elf...

If he could do it,
then surely I can too...
...I can no longer forgive his tyranny!
Please let me go with you too!

I intended to defeat Odin by taking
back the Dragon Orb.

But I don't know what I should
do for that...
...I have no choice but to rely on you...
...That's impossible.
Why!?
Humans cannot enter Yggdrasil.

There's nothing to be done about
this one...
But I can fire photons too...

You can't do object reading,
can you?
...You're just an ordinary human now.
See you, Alicia...

To go to Asgard, I will pass through the
gate of Bifrost deep in the Forest of Spirits.

...Shall we go together, at least as
far as we can go?
